title: Spectral sum rules on a $d$--sphere
summary: We derive spectral sum rules for inverse powers of the eigenvalues of the Helmholtz equation on a $d$-sphere in the presence of an arbitrary density. By adopting a rigorous renormalization scheme, we remove the divergent contributions of the zero mode and obtain exact expressions for the sum rules without requiring an explicit determination of the eigenvalues, which is generally impossible.
